title: Evertrail Idle: a multiplayer idle RPG in your browser, now in open alpha
author: Slapbox98
selftext:
for the past couple of months I've been making Evertrail Idle. It's an idle RPG you play in the browser. You pick a skill, your adventurer goes off and does it, and you check back whenever you feel like it. It keeps going when you close the tab, for up to a day, and after that your adventurer walks back to town to rest.

The part I care most about is that it's one shared world. Everyone who plays is in the same town, so when you're chopping trees or fishing off the shore you see other people doing their thing next to you. Every two hours there's a world event that anyone can join, like a giant oak everybody chops down together or a fire boss that crawls out of a lava lake.

There are 18 skills right now. The usual gathering and crafting ones, combat, and a couple of stranger ones. Exploration has you work your way up from a scout to a riverboat and eventually an airship. Diving you can do with a party of up to four.

I also just added Ironman mode. It's for new characters only and you play fully solo: no market, no trading, no parties. Ironmen get their own leaderboards. Those only opened this week, so everyone on them started from zero.

It's an open alpha. It's free, there's no invite, and you can play as a guest without making an account (you can pick a login later so you don't lose your character). It works on desktop and on your phone. It also means things break now and then and the balance still moves around. I put out fixes most days, a lot of them because someone reported something on Discord.

**AI Disclosure:** because I know a lot of you care and I'd rather just say it: I use AI tools a lot. Most of the code is written with Claude, and a fair amount of the 3D art was made with AI tools too. The base character models are bought assets. It's not a prompt it and ship it project though. I design every system, decide every number, test everything, and throw out a lot of it when it doesn't feel right. The repo is at about 1,950 commits since early September.

I would really love some feedback!

Desktop/Mobile compatible.

Play: [https://evertrailidle.com](https://evertrailidle.com/)

Discord: [https://discord.gg/9P82zm3bdK](https://discord.gg/9P82zm3bdK)

Thanks for reading, and sorry for the wall of text.
